title: Contextual Quality-Diversity Evolutionary Reinforcement Learning for HVAC Control in Tropical Commercial Buildings
abstract: arXiv:2608.11324v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This paper proposes a contextual quality-diversity evolutionary reinforcement-learning controller, CQD-ERL, for the supervisory control of a tropical, water-cooled chiller plant and its associated air side. Rather than converging to a single scalarised policy, the controller maintains a product archive of specialised policies indexed jointly by a data- driven operating context, a cluster of daily weather and load regime, and a context-invariant behaviour descriptor, filled by a gradient-free evolutionary operator and a soft-actor-critic policy-gradient operator that share one replay buffer. Every action is filtered through a deterministic safety shield before execution. The controller is trained on a two-tier reduced-order environment representing the latent load, cooling-tower approach and humidity constraints of a Singapore commercial building, and is evaluated over a full annual backtest against an ASHRAE Guideline 36 baseline.

translated_title: 面向热带商业建筑暖通空调控制的情境质量-多样性进化强化学习
translated_abstract: 本文提出了一种情境质量-多样性进化强化学习控制器（CQD-ERL），用于热带水冷制冷站及其相关空气侧的监督控制。该控制器不收敛于单一的标量化策略，而是维护一个专业策略的产品档案，该档案由数据驱动的运行情境、每日天气和负荷模式聚类以及情境不变的行为描述符联合索引，并通过共享一个回放缓冲区的无梯度进化算子和软演员-评论家策略梯度算子来填充。每个动作在执行前都经过确定性安全屏蔽的过滤。该控制器在代表新加坡商业建筑潜在负荷、冷却塔逼近度和湿度约束的两层降阶环境中进行训练，并在全年回测中与ASHRAE指南36基线进行评估。
tldr: 本文提出了一种情境质量-多样性进化强化学习控制器，通过维护多样化策略档案并应用安全屏蔽，在热带商业建筑暖通空调控制中优于ASHRAE指南36基线。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a contextual quality-diversity evolutionary reinforcement learning controller that maintains a diverse policy archive with safety shielding, outperforming an ASHRAE Guideline 36 baseline for HVAC control in tropical commercial buildings.
